title: Extension of Application Deadline for Various Posts (Assistant Executive Engineer, Assistant Director, Technical Assistant, Lab Assistant, Assistant Chemical Examiner, Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector)
summary: The Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission (APPSC) has extended the last date for online application submission for various direct recruitment posts until December 7, 2026, 11:59 PM. This extension was granted following requests from applicants. No further extensions will be provided.
eligibility_bullets: Assistant Executive Engineers in Various Engineering Services: Refer to official notification 27/2026, 31/2026, 32/2026, 34/2026, 35/2026, 36/2026 on psc.ap.gov.in for post-wise qualification and age criteria (Visit Official Site).

Assistant Director (Mines) in A.P. Mines & Geology Service: Refer to official notification 27/2026, 31/2026, 32/2026, 34/2026, 35/2026, 36/2026 on psc.ap.gov.in for post-wise qualification and age criteria (Visit Official Site).

Technical Assistant in A.P. Mines & Geology Sub Service: Refer to official notification 27/2026, 31/2026, 32/2026, 34/2026, 35/2026, 36/2026 on psc.ap.gov.in for post-wise qualification and age criteria (Visit Official Site).

Lab Assistant in A.P. Mining Subordinate Service: Refer to official notification 27/2026, 31/2026, 32/2026, 34/2026, 35/2026, 36/2026 on psc.ap.gov.in for post-wise qualification and age criteria (Visit Official Site).

Assistant Chemical Examiner in A.P. Prohibition & Excise Subordinate Service: Refer to official notification 27/2026, 31/2026, 32/2026, 34/2026, 35/2026, 36/2026 on psc.ap.gov.in for post-wise qualification and age criteria (Visit Official Site).

Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector in A.P. Transport Service: Refer to official notification 27/2026, 31/2026, 32/2026, 34/2026, 35/2026, 36/2026 on psc.ap.gov.in for post-wise qualification and age criteria (Visit Official Site).
